zh.title: 美海軍陸戰隊成功完成女武神無人機跨視距控制測試
zh.summary: 美國海軍陸戰隊員於電子戰測試中完成女武神無人機超視距數據鏈控制傳輸
body: 製造商克拉托斯於2026年8月18日透露，一名美國海軍陸戰隊員在2026年4月的測試中，於超視距鏈路上接管了克拉托斯女武神（Valkyrie）協同戰鬥無人機的控制權。該次試飛於加州南部的美軍海軍測試場進行，女武神無人機與多架F-35戰鬥機及一架F/A-18同飛，共同執行電子戰測試目標。
無人機由零發射距離發射架起飛，隨後自主返回回收點。控制權由地面站轉移至Autonodyne開發的人機介面。此外，一架XQ-58女武神無人機曾於2026年8月4日在猶他州試飛時墜毀，導致克拉托斯暫停試飛，但製造商未將兩起事件進行關聯。

en.title: US Marine takes BLOS control of Kratos Valkyrie drone during test
en.summary: US Marine Corps operator controlled a Kratos Valkyrie drone beyond line of sight during California test.
body: Kratos Defense revealed on August 18, 2026, that a US Marine took control of a Valkyrie collaborative combat aircraft beyond line of sight during an April 2026 test flight. Operating at a US Navy test range in southern California, the uncrewed jet flew alongside US Marine Corps F-35 fighters and an F/A-18 to execute joint electronic warfare objectives.

The aircraft launched from a zero-length launcher and returned autonomously to its recovery point. Control transferred from a ground control station to a Marine operator using an Autonodyne human-machine interface over a datalink. The disclosure followed an August 4, 2026 crash of an XQ-58 Valkyrie in Utah, which prompted Kratos to suspend flight testing.

facts.claim: Kratos Defense announced on August 18, 2026, that a US Marine took control of a Valkyrie drone beyond line of sight during an electronic warfare mission alongside F-35s and an F/A-18 in April 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: A US Marine took control of a Kratos Valkyrie drone beyond line of sight as it flew an electronic warfare mission alongside F-35s and an F/A-18 at a US Navy test range in southern California, the manufacturer revealed on August 18, 2026 .

facts.claim: Control of the Valkyrie passed from a ground control station to a Marine operator using an Autonodyne human-machine interface over a beyond-line-of-sight link.
facts.sourceQuote: Once the Valkyrie was airborne, control passed from a Kratos ground control station to a human-machine interface developed by Autonodyne

facts.claim: The flight was conducted by an integrated test team including US Marine Corps and US Navy test squadrons, Northrop Grumman, Autonodyne, and Kratos.
facts.sourceQuote: An integrated test team led by the Expeditionary Maritime Aviation-Advanced Development Team conducted the mission. It included a USMC operational test and evaluation squadron, US Naval Air Test and Evaluation squadrons, Northrop Grumman, Autonodyne and Kratos.

facts.claim: The USMC Valkyrie uncrewed aircraft launched from a zero-length launcher and returned autonomously to its recovery point.
facts.sourceQuote: The April 2026 flight began with the missionized United States Marine Corps (USMC) Valkyrie collaborative combat aircraft (CCA) launching from a zero-length launcher. The runway-independent aircraft later returned autonomously to its recovery point.

facts.claim: The disclosure followed an August 4, 2026 crash of an XQ-58 Valkyrie at Dugway Proving Ground in Utah, which led Kratos to suspend flight testing.
facts.sourceQuote: The announcement came two weeks after an XQ-58 Valkyrie crashed at the US Army’s Dugway Proving Ground in Utah on August 4, 2026, prompting Kratos to suspend Valkyrie flight testing .
